source_review_results.detail: Flow builders filter steps/artifacts to the selected Run. Inspector resolves saved record IDs and rejects a selected target from another active Run. Switching module or Run clears selection/content. Stage and model records retain explicit IDs; existing linked/reused artifacts remain source-linked rather than copied or invented.

Every recorded Deep model child gets a selectable node even when no action receipt exists. Model response raw text and validation/transport errors remain independently readable; absent action nodes remain missing. Empty/skipped wording does not guarantee an original answer exists.

Server JSON is HTML-escaped; dynamic views use createElement/textContent rather than treating saved text as HTML. JSON is lazily parsed from existing marked records, avoiding a second full evidence payload. Original anchors and no-script raw-record access remain available.

Input snapshots are displayed as inputs; model requests preserve ordered messages and output constraints; raw responses and error codes remain intact. Execution, delivery, validation, zero-row queries and missing/skipped routes are not treated as semantic model success. Existing database constraints restrict nonnull returned_rows to completed tool steps.

The server stores a renderer-source fingerprint with the published receipt. A changed renderer forces an unchanged database snapshot to be re-rendered while preserving the data version and snapshot contents; unchanged data/version is not represented as a business change.

Publication uses a new component directory, validates the pinned base manifest, limits overrides to configured Python files under docs/operations, and runs compose up only for workbench with --no-deps/--no-build/--pull never. Receipt checks preserve image, environment, command and non-source mounts and compare other running containers. Read-only --verify checks final manifest files, effective Compose/runtime and actual mounted override hashes.

Main v1.2-20261110-r4 and processing component remain distinct from workbench-20261110-r2. Deployment README documents the separate source/Compose and requires later unified releases to account for that actual component. Product-page P01-P04 and model tasks are not closed by the workbench UI change.
